title: The Mountaineer Minimum Effort Trek
statement:
A hiker prepares for a mountain hike across an R x C elevation grid. The hiker starts at top-left (0, 0) and wants to reach bottom-right (R - 1, C - 1).

A route's "effort" is defined as the maximum absolute difference in heights between two consecutive cells of the route.

Find the minimum effort required to travel from (0, 0) to (R - 1, C - 1).
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers R and C.
Next R lines: C space-separated integers.

sampleCases.explanation: Path 1->2->2->2->5 has maximum difference |2-2|=0, |5-2|=3? Path 1->3->5->3->5 has max effort 2.
